name: The Stone Circle
summary: Marvon Rivetseeker waits in Ratchet for a serpent-marked stone. He barely escaped the Sunken Temple, and hopes it will bring back his memories.

sections.title: Marvon's Memory
sections.body: Marvon Rivetseeker remembers the evil that touched everyone who entered the Sunken Temple. Escaping meant struggling through ooze spread across the floors. One place stayed with him: a large round room crowded with serpent statues.

sections.title: The Stone in Ratchet
sections.body: Marvon Rivetseeker found a round stone marked with what seems to be the same serpent symbol. He had it crated and sent to his workshop in Ratchet. Bring it to him, and he may remember more.

sections.title: When the Stone Returns
sections.body: Marvon Rivetseeker recognizes the stone as the right one. His memories begin to return.

aliases: who gives the stone circle quest
faq.answer: Marvon Rivetseeker asks you to bring him a stone. He once entered the Sunken Temple and barely escaped.
The stone was crated and sent to Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

faq.q: Why does Marvon want the stone circle?
faq.answer: The stone bears a serpent symbol like the statues Marvon Rivetseeker remembers from a round room in the Sunken Temple. With the stone in hand, he may be able to say more.

faq.q: What happened to Marvon in the Sunken Temple?
faq.answer: Marvon Rivetseeker barely escaped the Sunken Temple, wading through ooze spread across the floors. He remembers stumbling through a large round room filled with serpent statues.
